value.name: realizes she won't confess
value.description: Asha understands that she will not be the one to go to Whitfield's office and admit the paragraph was hers.
evidence: she had already understood, somewhere between the kitchen table and the car, that she was not going to be the one to walk into Whitfield's office and say it had been hers.
value.location_hint: between the kitchen table and the car

value.name: parks outside Devin's building
value.description: Asha pulls her car to the curb a few doors from Devin's building and turns off the engine.
evidence: Asha pulled to the curb a few doors down from Devin's building and cut the engine.

value.name: pauses before going inside
value.description: She sits still in the car, looking at Devin's lit second-floor window and steadying herself with a slow breath.
evidence: For a moment she sat with both hands still on the wheel, watching the lit second-floor window where she knew his desk was, and she let one slow breath out through her nose

value.name: reaches for the briefcase
value.description: Asha reaches for the briefcase, which is warm from the heater vent.
evidence: before she reached for the briefcase. The latch was warm under her palm from the heater vent.

value.name: carries the briefcase to the house
value.description: She gets out of the car, closes the door quietly, and walks toward Devin's front steps with the briefcase at her side.
evidence: She got out, closed the door quietly so as not to announce herself to the street, and walked the short stretch of sidewalk to his front steps with the briefcase held at her side

value.name: brings Devin's name inside
value.description: Asha carries the briefcase containing the document with Devin's name written inside in her own handwriting.
evidence: the briefcase held at her side the way she had set it on the passenger seat, his name inside it in her own handwriting.
